sentences.en: One day, Chris discovered the charming girl of his dreams.
sentences.zh: 一天，克里斯发现了他梦寐以求的那个迷人的女孩。

sentences.en: "Yes!", he whispered in my ear with his charming voice.
sentences.zh: “是的！”他用那令人陶醉的声音在我耳边低语。

sentences.en: You can be pretty charming when you want to be.
sentences.zh: 当你想的时候，你也可以很迷人。
